GET /api/hub/context.name: Hub context — who am I talking to (public)
GET /api/hub/context.description: The hub's identity and state before any session: hub_id, cloud_base_url, language, currency, whether a machine is registered, the PIN users. First request of every visit.

POST /api/auth/cloud.name: Open a session with the SaaS JWT
POST /api/auth/cloud.description: Send the SaaS user's JWT (`Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` — what the SaaS collection's Login saved). The hub verifies it (RS256), links or provisions the local user and opens a session. The response's `token` is saved as `hub_session`.
test: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set(k, v); };

POST /api/auth/set-pin.name: Set (or change) my PIN
POST /api/auth/set-pin.description: Sets the PIN of the session's user — SIX digits. `current_pin` is required when the user already has one (hub#1430); omit it right after the first cloud login.

POST /api/auth/pin.name: Open a session with name + PIN (the till's day-to-day login)
POST /api/auth/pin.description: Local login. The response's `token` is saved as `hub_session`. `device_id` identifies the client: the device-trust gate refuses a login that does not identify its device (`device_unidentified`).
test: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set(k, v); };

POST /api/auth/badge.name: Open a session with a badge (keyboard-wedge reader or iButton)
test: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set(k, v); };

POST /api/keys.name: Create an API key (the secret is shown ONCE — saved as hub_api_key)
POST /api/keys.description: Admin session. `access`: full · read_only · write_only · custom (then `scope` lists {module, read, write}). The secret starts with `erpl_live_` and is sent as `Authorization: Bearer` on `/api/v1/{module}/q|c/…` and on `/ws`.
test: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set(k, v); };

POST /api/keys/:id/rotate.name: Rotate an API key (new secret, saved as hub_api_key)
test: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set(k, v); };

GET /api/keys.name: API keys of the hub (without secrets)

POST /api/query.name: Run a declarative query of a module
POST /api/query.description: `name` is `<module>.<query>` as declared in the module's manifest; `params` are its bound parameters. Answers `{ok, data: rows}`. Any credential: session or API key.

POST /api/command.name: Run a declarative command of a module
POST /api/command.description: `name` is `<module>.<command>`; `payload` follows the command's JSON Schema. Answers `{ok, data}` or `{ok: false, error: {code, message}}`. Any credential: session or API key.

GET /api/v1/openapi.json.name: OpenAPI of THIS hub's modules — import it into Postman
GET /api/v1/openapi.json.description: The `expose_api` operations of the modules installed on this hub (`/api/v1/{module}/q|c/…`), as OpenAPI 3.1. Per hub: install a module and the API grows. Needs the setting `api_docs_enabled` = true (404 otherwise) and a user session. Import the response into Postman and use `Authorization: Bearer {{hub_api_key}}` on the imported requests.

GET /api/blueprints/catalog.name: Blueprint catalogue (proxied from the SaaS)
GET /api/blueprints/catalog.description: The blueprints published in the marketplace, by sector. Needed once, to pick the one the bench is built from.

GET /api/blueprints/:slug/download.name: Download a catalogue blueprint (zip)
GET /api/blueprints/:slug/download.description: The `*.blueprint.zip` of `slug`. Save it and feed it to POST /api/hub/import/inspect.

POST /api/hub/import/inspect.name: Inspect a blueprint zip before importing (binary body)
POST /api/hub/import/inspect.description: Body = the zip bytes (`application/octet-stream`, pick the file in Postman). Validates it and stages it: the response's `upload_id` goes into POST /api/hub/import.

POST /api/hub/import.name: Import a staged blueprint (migrate-style)
POST /api/hub/import.description: `upload_id` from inspect; `selection` chooses what to apply; `origin` (catalogue slug + version) makes a partial import retryable. Missing modules are installed from the marketplace best-effort; fiscal material lands as `pending`.

POST /api/hub/export.name: Export THIS hub as a blueprint zip
POST /api/hub/export.description: The bench's identity for recreation: everything selected, as a `*.blueprint.zip`. `settings_items` narrows the settings keys (never widens them, ADR-0195).

POST /api/members.name: Invite a SaaS user to this hub (per-hub membership, ADR-0201)

GET /api/members.name: SaaS users with a membership on this hub

PUT /api/settings.name: Update hub settings (partial object)
PUT /api/settings.description: An object of `hub_settings` keys to write. Admin session.

GET /api/hub/users.name: Local users of the hub (PIN users)

POST /api/hub/users.name: Create a local user (PIN user)
POST /api/hub/users.description: `NewHubUser` (crates/runtime/src/hub_users.rs): name, email, role, pin, badge. Admin session.

GET /api/devices.name: Devices that have logged into this hub

POST /api/hub/flows/:id/run.name: Run a flow by hand (the `manual` trigger) — returns the run id

GET /api/hub/flows/schema.name: The flow definition schema (triggers, steps, grants)

GET /api/hub/events.name: Recent events of the hub (the bus)

GET /readyz.name: Readiness — what the container HEALTHCHECK reads (public)

GET /modules/:id/*path.name: Static asset of an installed module (public)
